name: lumr-studio
description: Lumr Studio: a Claude plugin that cuts the gaps out of talking-head videos and helps you tweak the cut. Free to use. You can sell the videos you make, not the tool.

plugins.name: lumr-studio
plugins.description: Cuts the gaps out of a talking-head recording and helps you tweak the cut. Claude proposes each cut with a reason, and your footage stays on your machine.
